Synopsis:
    The US House of Representatives is set to consider a broad Russia sanctions bill — the "Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026" — already passed by the Senate 86-11. The bill targets Russian officials and would authorize steep tariffs on China, India and other nations buying Russian oil and gas. Passage is uncertain due to House Democratic opposition, Republican concerns over consumer cost impacts, and political sensitivity ahead of mid-term elections.
